author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

The Run-3 HLT menus are generated from ConfDB, so their python files are consistent by construction and come with tooling (`getHLT.sh`, `hltListPaths`, `getEventContent.py`, `getDatasets.py`). The Phase-2 menu in `HLTrigger/Configuration/python/HLT_75e33` is maintained by hand, one `_cfi` per object, and has no equivalent tooling: nothing catches broken or stale imports, orphaned files, or modules whose configuration no longer matches the file name, and the HTML menu documentation is produced with scripts that live outside the release.

This PR adds two scripts to `HLTrigger/Configuration/scripts`:

- `hltPhase2MenuCheck`: static consistency checks of the `HLT_75e33` tree. Files are parsed with the python AST (nothing is executed, no `cmsenv` needed). Errors (exit code 1): syntax errors (E001), `fragment.load(...)` or imports of missing files (E002), symbols used but neither defined nor imported (E003). Warnings (fatal only with `--strict`): files not reached from any entry point (W101), imports from which nothing is used (W102), `X_cfi.py` not defining `X` (W103), symbols defined in several files (W104), files loaded twice (W105). Entry points are all files in `HLTrigger/Configuration/python` that reference `HLT_75e33` (e.g. `HLT_75e33_cff.py`, `HLT_NGTScouting_cff.py`); more can be given with `--root`. Findings can be written as JSON and selectively ignored with `--ignore`.
- `hltPhase2MenuDump`: loads a configuration containing the menu (e.g. from `cmsDriver.py -s L1P2GT,HLT:75e33 --no_exec`) and provides:
  - text listings: `--list paths|seeds|modules|datasets|eventcontent` (Phase-2 counterparts of `hltListPaths`, `getDatasets.py`, `getEventContent.py`);
  - a JSON model of the menu (`--json`), which can also be used as input;
  - a static, self-contained HTML site (`-o DIR`, no external assets or network access, light/dark mode): a searchable and sortable path table (L1 seed, number of modules and filters, last filter); one page per path with the ordered module chain (filters, Task members, negated/ignored modules), the selection parameters of each filter, and the products consumed by the path whose producers it does not schedule; one page per module (plugin type, link to the plugin source and to its `_cfi` file, paths using it, inputs, consumers, full python dump); EventSetup, services, outputs/datasets pages; a checks page (modules in no path, paths not in the schedule, paths without an L1 seed module);
  - `--compare OTHER.json`: a differences page between two menus (e.g. default vs `alpaka` vs `ticl_v5`): paths and modules added, removed, reordered or reconfigured, and changed L1 seeds.

It also adds a `README.md` in `HLTrigger/Configuration/python/HLT_75e33/test` documenting the tools.

No change in any workflow output is expected: the PR only adds scripts, tests and documentation.

The HTML dumper is meant to replace the out-of-release scripts currently used to produce the Phase-2 menu documentation pages (e.g. https://evernazz.web.cern.ch/evernazz/NGT/site/Phase2Menu/GettingStarted/).

#### PR validation:

- New unit tests in `HLTrigger/Configuration/test`:
  - `test_hltPhase2MenuCheck.py`: runs the checker on a synthetic `HLT_75e33` tree with one planted defect per rule and requires exactly the expected findings and exit code (external star imports, e.g. from `RecoTracker`, must not produce false E003);
  - `test_hltPhase2MenuTools.sh`: static checks of the real tree, `cmsDriver.py` (`--no_exec`) for the default and `alpaka` menus, JSON/HTML dumps, sanity checks of the menu model (minimum number of `HLT_` paths, no empty paths, no references to unknown modules) and the diff page. Conditions, geometry and era can be overridden with `P2_CONDITIONS`, `P2_GEOMETRY`, `P2_ERA`.
- Both are registered in `HLTrigger/Configuration/test/BuildFile.xml` (`testHLTPhase2MenuCheckSelfTest`, `testHLTPhase2MenuCheck`, `testHLTPhase2MenuTools`).
- `scram b runtests_testHLTPhase2MenuTools` and `scram b runtests_testHLTPhase2MenuCheck` in `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-08-0000`.
- HTML output inspected for the default menu: [link to the generated page](https://marcomusich.web.cern.ch/display/html_default/)

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport. No backport foreseen.
title: Add static checker and menu dumper for the Phase-2 HLT menu (`HLT_75e33`)
